endorsements.quote: Whenever LLMs are being developed for primary care, their involvement is mandatory so that the final product feels not like a generic solution developed for all clinical settings broadly but rather like it was something that was made specifically for primary care clinicians and patients.

unlisted_practices: Use the CARE (context, action, result, example) framework as a structured method for designing LLM prompts.
Incorporate prompt engineering skills into undergraduate and graduate medical training.
Involve clinicians as co-developers in prompt engineering rather than only as evaluators of LLM outputs.

screen.reason: This is a commentary presenting recommendations (including the CARE framework for prompt engineering and clinician co-design) based on the development of a tool, rather than an empirical study.
